_about: Photo year game. Each photo is a free file on Wikimedia Commons; y = year taken, from the holding institution or photographer record, confirmed by a second independent field of the file record (description, category, archive year or Wikidata). Undated, circa, ranged and re-photographed items, event photos that may show the year on banners, and pictures of things older than photography were excluded. t = caption shown after answering, c = credit, u = Commons file page.
